hypothesis: An equal-weight reciprocal-rank-fusion consensus of five prior-only SONAR rankings improves Top-20 mean hits over BASE_EQUAL42 and is not materially inferior to its component rankings.

formula.weights: 1.0 for each of the five fixed source rankings
formula.tuning: none; one fixed formula and one fixed c=20

walk_forward.cutoff_rule: Every source rank vector is taken from the Q94 target ledger for that target; cutoff_date must be strictly earlier than target_date.
walk_forward.selection: No parameter or model selection. Discovery and Validation are descriptive; Blind OOS is evaluated once.

endpoints.primary: Top-20 mean hits per target versus BASE_EQUAL42
endpoints.comparators: Q97_RRF5 is compared with each of the five fixed source rankings.

inference.paired_test: One-sided block sign-flip on target-paired hit-count differences; contiguous blocks of 20, final partial block retained.
inference.bootstrap: Circular moving-block bootstrap, block length 20, percentile 95% interval.
inference.multiple_testing: One global Holm family across 5 comparators x 3 endpoints = 15 Blind OOS tests.
inference.exact_null: Per-target Hypergeometric(40,k,5), convolved over each split for BASE_EQUAL42 and Q97_RRF5.

guardrails: The five source rankings must each be complete permutations of 1..40.
Actual target quintets are read only after the RRF ranking has been constructed.
No source rank, formula, c value, split or endpoint is changed after evaluation.
The source snapshot preserves all five full 40-number rankings for each target.
No production engine, prospective freeze or Q60 ledger is modified.
No merge or promotion is permitted.
limitations: This is post-hoc exploratory because the component families were previously examined.
The historical Blind OOS is prior-exposed and is not a virgin prospective holdout.
Block sign-flip inference assumes exchangeability of contiguous 20-target block signs under the null.
RRF is a ranking aggregation, not a physical or causal mechanism.
No historical result establishes an advantage for future random draws.
next_action: Stop retrospective RRF tuning; continue the separate Q60 append-only prospective cohort until at least 200 complete paired targets.
